remarks: Welcome to 80 County! This bright and inviting 1-bed, 1-bath condo is truly move-in ready. Enjoy hardwood floors in both the living room and bedroom, a spacious layout, and an updated kitchen featuring granite countertops. The bedroom offers a generous walk-in closet and has been freshly painted for a crisp, clean feel. Start your mornings with coffee on your private balcony overlooking the expansive courtyard. The location can't be beat-just minutes to all that Norwalk has to offer, including great restaurants, the vibrant Norwalk Mall, beaches, transportation, entertainment, and more. When summer arrives, relax and unwind at the complex's in-ground pool-perfect for cooling off on hot days. If you're looking for a place to call your own, this condo is an excellent opportunity you won't want to miss! Subject to probate approval. Being sold "as is"
